variants.title: 1 · Thread open (pin + popover)
variants.description: CHR-1250/1251: numbered pins (Human blue, Agent purple), active pin with a ring, element outline, popover to the right of the element. The Context sidebar keeps only the count row (CHR-1253).

variants.title: 2 · Comment mode + new thread
variants.description: CHR-1252: the mode starts from the top-bar icon or C, with a hint bar that names Esc. Hover shows an outline and a node id label; a click opens an empty popover at the node, with an @-mention list for agents. Existing pins are dimmed.

variants.title: 3 · Detached thread + more menu
variants.description: CHR-1249/1250: node n184 no longer exists after the re-render. The thread is not deleted: its pin moves, dashed and amber, to a "Detached" tray left of the screen. The popover explains the state and offers re-anchor; the more menu is open.

variants.title: 4 · Popover flip + show resolved
variants.description: CHR-1251/1252: the element sits at the right edge, so the popover opens to the left. "Show resolved" is on: resolved threads appear as grey pins with a check mark. One thread is resolved and can be reopened (Reopen).
